title: 第268章 被发现了第267章 灵域门主来了
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了第一卷：默认第268章被发现了（..la）磅礴的杀气从林昊身上轰然爆发，充斥整栋大堂，冰冷刺骨的压迫感让在场所有人呼吸一滞。
两大护法赵威、李奎，以及跪地的三位长老，全都清晰感受到门主极致的怒火与杀意，心底莫名发紧，生出浓浓的忌惮与紧张。
良久，林昊强行压下胸中翻腾的怒火，缓缓收敛周身杀气。
大堂内压抑的氛围才稍稍缓和。
他面色依旧冰冷，沉声开口询问：“那两个凶手，现在在哪？”
石峰连忙躬身回话，语气恭敬：“回门主，陈阳那小子和白若兰一行人目前住在汕城大酒店，我们随时可以为您带路。”
说完，石峰三位长老连忙从地上站起身，不敢多做停留，转身率先朝着别墅外走去，准备引路。
林昊面色冰冷，冷哼一声，带着赵威、李奎两大护法，紧随其后踏出大堂。
一行人快步走出别墅，来到室外开阔的停车区域。
几辆黑色商务车整齐停靠在路边，司机早已等候多时。
路边还站着十多名灵域门弟子，个个身姿挺拔，身着统一制式的劲装，气息凝练，眼神锐利，皆是宗门精锐。
众人见门主一行人出来，立刻收敛神色，快步跟上队伍，随时待命。
而停车区左侧的隐蔽角落，树荫浓密、视野遮挡，陈阳正单手轻轻揽着百合的腰身。
两人周身笼罩着一层透明灵力屏障，开启隐身状态，静静藏在暗处，将前方所有人的动作尽收眼底。
百合身子微微贴近陈阳，压低音量，凑到他耳边小声提醒：“陈少，那个气场最强的中年男人，就是灵域门门主林昊。”
陈阳微微点头，眼神瞬间变得锐利，双眼亮起微光，立刻催动透视能力，径直穿透林昊的身躯，探查其丹田修为。
看清对方的修为境界，陈阳心底微微一沉。
林昊的修为居然已经达到炼气境九层后期！
他如今只是炼气境九层前期，对方足足高出自己两个小境界，修为底蕴差距极大。
这时，百合再次压低声音，小声补充提醒：“陈少，跟在林昊身边的两人是宗门两大护法赵威和李奎，传闻他们两人的修为都极强，实力不容小觑。”

陈阳继续催动透视，依次探查这两大护法的丹田。
只见赵威与李奎的修为都达到了炼气境八层中期，实力远超普通长老。
紧接着，他又快速探查石峰、叶尘、封狼三位长老的修为，发现三人的伤势已经完全恢复，修为尽数归位，分别是炼气境六层前期与两位炼气境五层后期，整体实力还算扎实。
最后，陈阳目光扫过其余随行的十多名弟子，所有人修为都卡在炼气境三层到四层之间，在普通修士中不算弱，但在他眼中，完全不值一提，根本入不了他的眼。
探查完所有人的实力，陈阳的目光再次牢牢锁定在林昊身上，心底暗自盘算对敌之法。
就在这时，正要弯腰上车的林昊，动作骤然一顿，猛地转头，锐利的目光直直穿透层层遮挡，精准望向陈阳与百合隐身躲藏的角落，眼神充满警惕。
处于隐身状态的陈阳心头骤然一紧，瞬间生出强烈的危机感，暗道不好，被发现了！
他来不及多想，低声快速道：“我们快跑！”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Awakening of the Yin-Yang Magic: I felt numb after the breakup. Volume 1: Default Chapter 268 was discovered (..la). The majestic murderous aura burst out from Lin Hao's body, filling the entire lobby, and the cold and biting oppression made everyone present breathless.
The two guardians Zhao Wei and Li Kui, as well as the three elders kneeling on the ground, all clearly felt the extreme anger and murderous intention of the sect master, and their hearts tightened inexplicably, giving rise to deep fear and tension.
For a long time, Lin Hao suppressed the rage in his chest and slowly restrained the murderous aura around him.
The depressing atmosphere in the lobby eased slightly.
His face was still cold, and he asked in a deep voice: "Where are the two murderers now?"
Shi Feng quickly bowed and replied with a respectful tone: "Back to the master, that boy Chen Yang and Bai Ruolan and their group are currently staying at Shancheng Hotel. We can guide you at any time."
After saying that, the three elders of Shi Feng quickly stood up from the ground, not daring to stay any longer. They turned around and walked towards the outside of the villa, preparing to lead the way.
Lin Hao looked cold, snorted coldly, and followed the two guardians Zhao Wei and Li Kui out of the lobby.
The group of people quickly walked out of the villa and came to the open parking area outside.
Several black commercial vehicles were parked neatly on the roadside, and the drivers had been waiting for a long time.
There are still more than a dozen disciples of the Spirit Realm Sect standing on the roadside. They are all tall and straight, wearing uniform uniforms, with condensed auras and sharp eyes. They are all elites of the sect.
When everyone saw the sect leader and his entourage coming out, they immediately calmed down and quickly followed the team, ready for action at any time.
In the hidden corner on the left side of the parking area, where trees are thickly shaded and the view is blocked, Chen Yangzheng is gently holding Lily's waist with one hand.
The two of them were surrounded by a transparent spiritual barrier, turning on the invisibility state, hiding quietly in the dark, and having a panoramic view of the movements of everyone in front of them.
Lily leaned slightly closer to Chen Yang, lowered her voice, and whispered in his ear: "Mr. Chen, the middle-aged man with the strongest aura is Lin Hao, the leader of the Spirit Realm Sect."
Chen Yang nodded slightly, his eyes instantly became sharp, his eyes shimmered, and he immediately activated his clairvoyance ability to penetrate Lin Hao's body and explore his Dantian cultivation.
Chen Yang's heart sank slightly after seeing clearly the other party's cultivation level.
Lin Hao's cultivation has actually reached the late stage of the ninth level of Qi Refining Realm!
He is currently in the early stage of the ninth level of Qi Refining Realm, and the opponent is two levels higher than him, with a huge gap in cultivation base.
At this time, Lily lowered her voice again and added a reminder in a low voice: "Mr. Chen, the two people following Lin Hao are the two great protectors of the sect, Zhao Wei and Li Kui. It is said that both of them have extremely strong cultivation and their strength should not be underestimated."
Chen Yang continued to use clairvoyance to explore the Dantian of these two protectors.
I saw that the cultivation levels of Zhao Wei and Li Kui had reached the middle stage of the eighth level of Qi Refining Realm, and their strength far exceeded that of ordinary elders.
Immediately afterwards, he quickly checked the cultivation levels of the three elders Shi Feng, Ye Chen, and Feng Lang, and found that the injuries of the three elders had been fully recovered, and their cultivation levels had all returned to their original positions. They were in the early stage of the sixth level of Qi Refining Realm and the two were in the late stage of the fifth level of Qi Refining Realm. Their overall strength was quite solid.
Finally, Chen Yang glanced at the other dozen or so disciples who were accompanying him. All of them were stuck between the third and fourth levels of the Qi Refining Realm. They were not weak among ordinary monks, but in his eyes, they were completely insignificant and could not catch his eye at all.
After exploring everyone's strength, Chen Yang's eyes were firmly fixed on Lin Hao again, secretly planning a way to defeat the enemy.
At this moment, Lin Hao, who was about to bend down to get into the car, suddenly stopped and turned his head sharply. His sharp eyes penetrated through the layers of obstructions and looked precisely at the corner where Chen Yang and Lily were hiding, his eyes full of vigilance.
In the invisible state, Chen Yang's heart suddenly tightened, and he instantly felt a strong sense of crisis. The secret passage was not good and was discovered!
He didn't have time to think too much and said quickly in a low voice: "Let's run!"
